description: This Java source file defines the AuthoritiesImpl class, which implements authority and permission management for resources and operations within the org.eclipse.hono.auth package. It provides methods to add authorities, check authorization, and create authorities from JWT claims.

classes.name: AuthoritiesImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing the Authorities interface, managing authorities for resources and operations, with methods to add, check, and create authorities from JWT claims.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates Authorities instance from JWT claims, adding claims that start with resource or operation prefixes.

methods.name: addOperation
methods.description: Adds an authority to execute a specific operation on a resource, either with or without tenant.

methods.name: addResource
methods.description: Adds an authority for activities on a resource, with optional tenant.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Incorporates authorities from another Authorities object into this instance.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a resource and activity or operation is authorized based on stored authorities.
